scope: Static upstream systemd v262.1 documentation review; the booted Fedora package is 262.1. This does not establish distro binary/source equivalence.
excerpt: PrivatePIDs= takes a boolean and defaults to false. When enabled, it creates a new PID namespace for executed processes; each executed process is PID 1 and /proc only shows processes in that namespace. It implies MountAPIVFS=yes, applies only to service units, and is unsupported with Type=forking. It was added in version 257.
application: s.service is a Type=oneshot service. PrivatePIDs=yes makes its fixed bootc process PID 1 with a private /proc. The pinned bootc source treats PID 1 as already isolated when /proc/1/ns/mnt and /proc/self/ns/mnt match. If PID namespaces are unavailable or the native behavior differs, bootc status or the service-result check fails closed.
limits: The collector retains only CAP_SYS_ADMIN, empty ambient capabilities, no-new-privileges, a private mount namespace and existing resource ceilings. CAP_SYS_PTRACE is not granted. Native confirmation remains required.
